meta.title: The Broken Starship
meta.subtitle: Your ship crashes on a strange moon after receiving a mysterious signal from deep space.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: 🚀 Emergency Landing
scenes.narrative:
Red warning lights flash across the control room as your starship shakes violently.

A mysterious signal pulled your ship out of course, and now you have crash-landed on a cold, silver moon. Outside the cracked window, you see three possible places to investigate: a glowing cave, a ruined station, and your damaged engine room.

scenes.title: ✨ The Glowing Cave
scenes.narrative:
The cave walls glow with blue crystals. The air feels warm, even though the moon outside is freezing.

Deep inside, you hear a low humming sound. A trail of strange footprints leads farther into the darkness.

choices.text: Leave the cave and go to the station

scenes.title: 🏚️ The Ruined Station
scenes.narrative:
The station looks abandoned, but the doors still have power. Inside, dust floats through the air and old computer screens flicker.

One screen shows the same signal that caused your crash.

choices.text: Follow a strange noise down the hall

scenes.title: ⚙️ The Engine Room
scenes.narrative:
Smoke pours from the engine core. Sparks jump from broken wires, and the ship's computer warns that power is almost gone.

You might be able to repair the ship, but you need a new energy source.

choices.text: Try to repair the engine now
Search for an energy source outside

scenes.title: 📋 The Old Logs
scenes.narrative:
The logs explain that the station crew discovered an alien artifact buried under the moon. The artifact sends out a signal to pull ships toward it.

The final log says: Do not activate the core.

scenes.title: 📦 The Storage Room
scenes.narrative:
You find a survival pack, a laser cutter, and an old access card.

These tools could help you reach places that were locked before.

choices.text: Use the access card on the lower elevator
Use the laser cutter to open a sealed door
Take the survival pack and leave

scenes.title: 🤖 Security Drone
scenes.narrative:
A damaged security drone rolls out from the shadows. Its red scanner locks onto you.

It asks for station identification, but you do not have any.

choices.text: Say you are here to fix the signal

scenes.title: 💨 Narrow Escape
scenes.narrative:
You sprint through the hallway as laser blasts hit the walls behind you.

You barely escape by diving through a broken doorway.

scenes.title: 🆘 Unexpected Help
scenes.narrative:
The drone pauses. Its scanner turns green.

It believes you are a repair worker and opens a secure elevator for you. The elevator leads deep underground.

choices.text: Ask the drone about the artifact

scenes.title: 🥚 The Nest
scenes.narrative:
You follow the footprints into a wide chamber filled with glowing eggs.

Something moves above you. A tall alien creature watches silently from the ceiling.

choices.text: Offer a crystal as a sign of peace

scenes.title: 💎 Crystal Power
scenes.narrative:
You carefully break off a glowing crystal. It pulses with energy in your hand.

This could power your ship, but it also seems connected to the strange signal.

choices.text: Bring the crystal back to the ship

scenes.title: 👽 The Silent Ally
scenes.narrative:
The alien lowers itself from the ceiling and gently takes the crystal.

Instead of attacking, it points toward a hidden tunnel beneath the cave. It seems to want you to stop the signal.

scenes.title: 🔬 The Hidden Lab
scenes.narrative:
Behind the sealed door is a secret laboratory. Notes cover the walls.

The scientists were trying to control the artifact, but it became unstable. A warning flashes on a monitor: Core overload possible.

scenes.title: 🌌 The Artifact Chamber
scenes.narrative:
You enter a huge underground chamber. A black metal artifact floats above the floor, spinning slowly.

Every few seconds, it releases a pulse of energy. This is what pulled your ship here.

choices.text: Take a piece of the artifact

scenes.title: 🔧 One Last Repair
scenes.narrative:
You place the crystal inside the engine core. The ship roars back to life.

The moon trembles as the strange signal grows louder. You can leave now, or you can stay and stop whatever is causing it.

choices.text: Stay and find the signal source

scenes.title: 📡 The Distress Signal
scenes.narrative:
You send a distress signal into space.

For a moment, there is only static. Then something answers. It is not human.

scenes.title: 🛸 Strange Rescue
scenes.narrative:
A massive alien ship appears above the moon.

A beam of light surrounds your broken ship. You are rescued, but you are taken somewhere far beyond known space.

scenes.title: ✅ Signal Destroyed
scenes.narrative:
You shut down the artifact. The chamber goes silent.

Above you, the storm around the moon fades. Your ship is damaged, but the moon is safe, and no more ships will be pulled into danger.

You survive as the explorer who ended the signal.

scenes.title: 🚀 Escape
scenes.narrative:
You launch your repaired ship and blast away from the moon.

Behind you, the signal continues to pulse. You survived, but something on that moon is still waiting.

scenes.title: 🔍 The Discovery
scenes.narrative:
You download the research files and escape with proof of alien technology.

The discovery changes human history forever, but part of you wonders if the artifact should have stayed hidden.

scenes.title: 💥 Engine Failure
scenes.narrative:
You try to repair the engine without the right parts.

The core overheats, sparks fly, and the ship loses power completely. You are stranded on the moon with no way home.

scenes.title: ⚡ Security Override
scenes.narrative:
You attack the drone, but its armor is too strong.

It fires once. The hallway flashes red, and your mission ends there.

scenes.title: 🌑 The Nest Awakens
scenes.narrative:
The moment you touch the egg, the entire nest comes alive.

The alien above you screeches, and more shadows move in the dark.

You do not make it out.

scenes.title: 🌀 The Void Opens
scenes.narrative:
You activate the artifact core.

A black portal tears open in the air. Stars appear inside it, but they are not stars from your universe.

The portal pulls you in, and the chamber vanishes behind you.

scenes.title: 💀 The Cursed Fragment
scenes.narrative:
You break off a piece of the artifact and hide it in your pack.

At first, nothing happens. Then the voices begin whispering inside your helmet.

You leave the moon, but the artifact leaves with you.
